# use_skill_tool

> Fetch a Skill so you can use it locally.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | `skills` |
| Callable | MCP clients; in-app @ai conversations (default) |
| Filter | `https://www.dsiloed.com/api/v1/mcp?tools=use_skill_tool` |

## Description

This is the description the server sends to the model, verbatim.

Fetch a Skill so you can use it locally. Skills follow the Agent Skills open
standard (SKILL.md = instructions + optional scripts/reference files).

- Call with NO name to LIST the available skills (name, description, tier).
- Call with a `name` to GET that skill's full SKILL.md content: the
  instructions, any sandboxed-JavaScript scripts (with their code), and
  reference-file links. Follow the instructions and run it in your own
  environment.

Tiers tell you what a skill needs: `native` (instructions only) /
`javascript` (sandboxed JS) / `python` (a Python script) /
`requires-silolink` (a real coding sandbox — that's you).

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | no | Skill name to fetch. Omit to list all available skills. |
